connection.title: Controller Connection
connection.description:
Connect your Violet Pool Controller to Home Assistant. Ensure the controller shares the same network and the API is reachable.

Additional docs: [DE]({docs_de}) · [EN]({docs_en})

data_description.verify_ssl: Verify the SSL certificate. Disable for self-signed certificates.
data_description.device_name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant
data_description.device_id: Unique ID if multiple controllers exist

pool_setup.title: Pool Configuration
pool_setup.description: Provide pool size, type and disinfection method. These values are used for runtime optimisation, energy management and dosing calculations.

feature_selection.title: Enable Smart Features
feature_selection.description: Enable only the features your pool installation actually uses. This keeps resource usage low and the UI tidy. You can adjust the selection at any time in the options.

data_description.enable_filter_control: Control the filter pump on demand

sensor_selection.title: Select Sensors
sensor_selection.description:
Choose which sensors you want to see in Home Assistant. Enable or disable individual sensors to keep your dashboard clean and focused.

**Tip:** All available sensors are selected by default. You can adjust this selection at any time in the options.

data_description.reconfigure_option: Choose the settings you want to update

Update the connection settings for your controller.

data_description.verify_ssl: Verify the SSL certificate. Disable for self-signed certificates.

reconfigure_safety.title: 🚨 Safety Settings
reconfigure_safety.description:
🚨 **CRITICAL SAFETY WARNING** 🚨

Enabling unsafe switches allows direct manual control of:
• Dosing systems (chemical overdose risk)
• Backwash/Rinse (equipment damage risk)
• Water Refill (flooding/overflow risk)

These operations can run INDEFINITELY without time limits!

**SAFE ALTERNATIVE**: Use Services instead - they require mandatory time limits.

⚠️ Only enable this if you fully understand and accept the risks!

data_description.allow_unsafe_switches: Enable direct control of dosing, backwash & refill (requires mandatory time limits via Services)

repair.title: Repair Controller Connection
repair.description:
The controller **{controller_name}** is not responding.

Verify the controller is powered on and connected to the network, then update the connection settings below.

controller_auth.title: Enter controller login
controller_auth.description: The controller **{controller_name}** only accepts commands with valid login data. Enter the username and password of the controller - leave both empty if it really runs without a login.

error.invalid_ip_address:
**Invalid IP address**

Please enter a valid IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.100)
error.cannot_connect:
**Connection failed**

Controller unreachable. Check:
• Is the IP address correct?
• Is the controller powered on?
• Is the network connection OK?
error.invalid_auth:
**Login failed**

Username or password incorrect. If authentication is disabled, leave the fields empty.
error.timeout_connection:
**Connection timeout**

Controller is not responding. It may be overloaded or unreachable.
error.authentication_error:
**Authentication required**

The controller requires login credentials. Please enter username and password.
error.api_endpoint_not_found:
**API endpoint not found**

Controller firmware may be outdated or the URL is incorrect.
error.invalid_pool_size:
**Invalid pool size**

Value must be between 0.1 and 1000 m³.
error.invalid_configuration:
**Configuration error**

One or more inputs are invalid. Please review.
error.api_response_error:
**Invalid controller response**

Controller is sending unexpected data. Firmware update needed?
error.firmware_data_missing:
**Firmware info missing**

Controller firmware version could not be determined.
error.invalid_firmware_version:
**Firmware issue**

Controller firmware appears outdated. Please update.
error.connection_error:
**Network error**

General connection error. Check network settings.
error.already_configured:
**Already configured**

A controller with this IP address is already set up.
error.agreement_declined:
**Setup cancelled**

Setup was cancelled because the safety notice was not accepted.
error.unknown:
**Unknown error**

An unexpected problem occurred. If it persists, contact support.

abort.repair_successful: Repair successful – controller is back online

init.title: Adjust Pool Settings
init.description:
**What would you like to configure?**

Enable/disable features
Select sensors
🚨 Safety settings
Change settings

**Tip:** You can return to this selection at any time.

data_description.config_option: Choose what you want to adjust

features.title: Enable/Disable Features
features.description:
**Select the features you want to use**

Enabled features are shown in Home Assistant
Disabled features are hidden

**Tip:** Only enable what you really need — this keeps the interface clean!

sensors.title: Select Sensors
sensors.description:
**Choose which datapoints to use**

Every entity built from a datapoint follows this selection — sensors, switches, lights and controls alike
Changes take effect immediately

**Tip:** Only select what you actually want to see!

data_description.allow_unsafe_switches: Enable direct control of dosing, backwash & refill (requires mandatory time limits via Services)

settings.title: General Settings
settings.description:
**Adjust technical parameters**

Polling interval: How often data is fetched
Timeout: Maximum wait time for responses
Retry attempts: Number of retry attempts

**Tip:** Default values work for most setups!

data_description.adaptive_polling: Poll the controller less often while pump, heating and dosing are all off. The interval above stays the fastest rate.
data_description.retry_attempts: Number of retry attempts on failure (1-10)
data_description.group_entities: Split the controller's entities across sub-devices (pump, heating, dosing, ...) instead of listing all of them under one device. Entity IDs are not affected.

controller_unavailable.message: Pool controller {name} is unavailable after {failures} consecutive failures

device_not_found.message: No Violet Pool Controller found for device {device_id}

no_api_key.message: No API key configured for entity {entity}

no_data.message: The controller has not delivered any data yet

no_devices.message: No Violet Pool Controller was selected for this service call

no_parameters.message: No parameters were given for {service} - nothing to change

read_only_entity.message: Entity {entity} is read-only and cannot be controlled manually

value_out_of_range.message: Value {value} is outside the valid range ({min}–{max})

confirm.title: Retry the connection
confirm.description:
The pool controller **{name}** has been unreachable for {failures} consecutive polling cycles.

Please check:
- Is the controller powered on?
- Is the network connection OK?
- Is the IP address still correct?

Once the controller is reachable again, this issue will be resolved automatically.

Continuing reloads the integration and contacts the controller again.

abort.still_unavailable: The controller is still not responding. Check power, network and IP address, then try again.

controller_requires_auth.title: Controller requires a login
controller_requires_auth.description: The controller {name} rejected a command because authentication is missing or wrong. This happens when the integration was set up without username and password. Enter the controller's login data to fix it.

clear_error_history.name: Clear Error History
clear_error_history.description: Clear error history after successful recovery (use with caution).

logic.name: Comparison logic
logic.description: Use >= (greater than or equal) or <= (less than or equal)

threshold.name: Threshold value
threshold.description: Trigger value for the analog input

configure_overflow.name: Configure Overflow Protection
configure_overflow.description:
Configure overflow, dry-run and bathing-detection protection.

Only the fields you fill in are written to the controller, so raising the overflow level cannot switch on another protection as a side effect.

enabled.name: Enable overflow protection
enabled.description: Enable or disable the overflow protection.

dryrun_level.name: Dry-run level
dryrun_level.description: Water level below which dry-run protection trips, in percent.

overflow_level.name: Overflow level
overflow_level.description: Water level above which overflow protection trips, in percent.

overflow_rpm.name: Drain pump speed
overflow_rpm.description: Pump speed used while draining an overflow (0-3).

bathing_ai_enabled.name: Enable bathing detection
bathing_ai_enabled.description: Detect bathers from the water level and react to it.

bathing_level_change.name: Bathing level change
bathing_level_change.description: Level change that counts as bathing, in percent.

bathing_level_time.name: Bathing time window
bathing_level_time.description: Time window for that level change, in seconds.

bathing_pump_rpm.name: Bathing pump speed
bathing_pump_rpm.description: Pump speed used during bathing detection (0-3).

configure_refill.name: Configure Water Refill
configure_refill.description:
Configure the automatic water refill system.

Only the fields you fill in are written to the controller.

refill_type.name: Refill sensor type
refill_type.description: Which level sensor drives the refill (1-3).

enabled.name: Enable refill
enabled.description: Enable or disable the automatic refill.

max_fill_time.name: Maximum fill time
max_fill_time.description: Upper limit for a single refill run, in seconds.

target_level.name: Target level
target_level.description: Water level the refill aims for, in percent.

blocks_dosing.name: Block dosing
blocks_dosing.description: Suspend chemical dosing while the refill runs.

configure_sensor_calibration.name: Configure Sensor Calibration
configure_sensor_calibration.description: Configure temperature sensor calibration offsets and multipliers.

logic.name: Comparison logic
logic.description: Use >= (greater than or equal) or <= (less than or equal)

control_backwash_http.name: Control Backwash (HTTP)
control_backwash_http.description:
Run or abort the filter backwash cycle.

**Caution:** a duration is mandatory - the backwash is stopped automatically when it elapses.

action.name: Backwash action
action.description: Start the backwash cycle or abort it

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the backwash may run (10-3600s). It is stopped automatically afterwards.

safety_override.name: Override safety interval
safety_override.description: Skip the cooldown between two backwash runs.

control_cover_http.name: Control Cover (HTTP)
control_cover_http.description: Control the pool cover (open, close, or stop).

control_dmx_scenes.name: DMX Scene Control
control_dmx_scenes.description: Control DMX lighting scenes for pool area illumination.

action.name: DMX action
action.description: Select: all_on, all_off, all_auto, sequence, or party_mode.

sequence_delay.name: Sequence delay (seconds)
sequence_delay.description: Delay between scenes in sequence mode (1-60s).

control_extension_relay.name: Control Extension Relay
control_extension_relay.description: Control a single extension relay output (EXT1_1 to EXT1_8 and EXT2_1 to EXT2_8).

bank.name: Extension module
bank.description: Which extension module the relay sits on (1 or 2).

action.name: Relay action
action.description: Select: on (manual ON), off (manual OFF), or auto (back to the controller's own rules).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the action, in seconds (0 = until changed).

control_heater_http.name: Control Heater (HTTP)
control_heater_http.description: Control the pool heater with temperature setpoint.

control_pump.name: Pump Control
control_pump.description: Control the pool pump with advanced options like speed, eco mode, or boost.

action.name: Control action
action.description: Select: speed_control, force_off, eco_mode, boost_mode, or auto.

duration.name: Duration (seconds)
duration.description: How long to apply the action (0 = indefinite).

control_pump_http.name: Control Pump (HTTP)
control_pump_http.description:
Control the filter pump directly.

Speed 1-3 switches the pump to manual ON at that speed; use action "off" or force_off to switch it off.

action.name: Control action
action.description: Select: on, off, eco, or boost.

force_off.name: Force off
force_off.description: Switch the pump off regardless of the other fields.

control_refill_http.name: Control Water Refill (HTTP)
control_refill_http.description:
Start or stop a manual water refill.

**Caution:** a duration is mandatory - the valve is closed automatically when it elapses so the pool cannot overflow.

action.name: Refill action
action.description: Select: fill to start, stop to end a running refill.

duration_seconds.name: Duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long to fill (10-3600s). The refill stops automatically afterwards.

safety_override.name: Override safety interval
safety_override.description: Skip the cooldown between two refill runs.

enable_dosing.name: Enable Dosing
enable_dosing.description: Enable or disable a dosing system.

enabled.name: Enable dosing
enabled.description: Turn dosing system on or off

enable_rule.name: Enable/Disable Rule
enable_rule.description: Enable or disable any rule type.

rule_type.name: Rule type
rule_type.description: Select rule type: temprule, analogrule, switchingrule, or timerrule

export_diagnostic_logs.name: Export diagnostic logs
export_diagnostic_logs.description:
Exports **recent integration logs** for troubleshooting and support.

Collects relevant log entries and enables download or file storage.

**Tip:** Useful for problems or when sending logs to support!

device_id.name: Pool Controller
device_id.description: Violet Pool Controller for the export

lines.name: Number of lines
lines.description: How many recent log lines to export? (10-1000)

include_timestamps.name: Include timestamps
include_timestamps.description: Include timestamps in the exported logs

save_to_file.name: Save as file
save_to_file.description: Save logs as text file in the /config/ directory

include_config.name: Include configuration
include_config.description: Include the integration configuration in the export.

include_history.name: Include history
include_history.description: Include the poll and error history in the export.

include_states.name: Include entity states
include_states.description: Include the current entity states in the export.

include_raw_data.name: Include raw data
include_raw_data.description: Include the raw controller readings in the export.

get_backwash_status.name: Get Backwash Status
get_backwash_status.description: Return the backwash state, the current step and the filter pressure.

get_calibration_status.name: Get Calibration Status
get_calibration_status.description: Return the calibration state of every calibrated sensor.

get_connection_status.name: Get Connection Status
get_connection_status.description: Get detailed connection status and health metrics for troubleshooting.

get_error_summary.name: Get Error Summary
get_error_summary.description: Get summary of recent errors and recovery suggestions.

get_live_trace_snapshot.name: Get live trace snapshot
get_live_trace_snapshot.description: Return a single-row snapshot of every controller reading.

get_overflow_status.name: Get Overflow Status
get_overflow_status.description: Return the overflow protection's configuration and live state.

get_refill_status.name: Get Refill Status
get_refill_status.description: Return the refill system's configuration and live state.

get_system_services_status.name: Get system service states
get_system_services_status.description: Return the live state of all controller-side system services.

get_system_update_status.name: Get Firmware Update Status
get_system_update_status.description: Return the installed and available controller firmware versions.

manage_digital_rules.name: Digital Rules Management
manage_digital_rules.description: Manage digital input automation rules for controller inputs.

rule_key.name: Rule to manage
rule_key.description: Select the digital rule (DIRULE_1 through DIRULE_8).

manage_pv_surplus.name: PV Surplus Management
manage_pv_surplus.description:
Control photovoltaic surplus mode for optimal solar power utilisation.

Pool devices are automatically powered with surplus solar energy.

mode.name: PV surplus mode
mode.description: Select: activate or deactivate. The controller knows no AUTO mode for PV surplus.

pump_speed.name: Pump speed
pump_speed.description: Desired pump output for PV mode (1=Eco, 2=Normal, 3=Maximum).

manual_dosing_http.name: Manual Dosing (HTTP)
manual_dosing_http.description:
Manually trigger chemical dosing.

**Caution:** Always verify water values before dosing!

dosing_system.name: Chemical system
dosing_system.description: Select the chemical to dose (chlorine, electrolysis, pH-, pH+, flocculant). H₂O₂ is not offered: it shares the chlorine output and the controller API has no way to select it, so a manual run would dose chlorine.

runtime_seconds.name: Runtime (seconds)
runtime_seconds.description: How long to run the dosing pump (1-3600s)

safety_override.name: Override safety interval
safety_override.description: Skip the cooldown between two dosing runs.

reset_blocking.name: Reset fault blockings
reset_blocking.description: Clears fault-induced blockings on the controller (e.g. BLOCKED_BY_ESC after empty-canister alarm). Useful after fixing the underlying issue.

set_can_amount.name: Set canister fill level
set_can_amount.description: Update the canister fill level for a dosing channel after refilling. With action=reset the daily-dosing counter is also cleared.

dosing_key.name: Dosing channel
dosing_key.description: Dosing channel key (DOS_1_CL, DOS_2_ELO, DOS_4_PHM, DOS_5_PHP, DOS_6_FLOC)

action.name: Action
action.description: adjust = only update fill level; reset = also clear daily counter

set_dosing_daytime.name: Set Dosing Daytime
set_dosing_daytime.description: Configure the daytime window for dosing operations.

set_dosing_max_daily.name: Set Dosing Maximum Daily
set_dosing_max_daily.description: Set the maximum daily dosing volume.

max_daily_ml.name: Maximum daily volume
max_daily_ml.description: Maximum volume in ml per day (10-10000)

set_dosing_target.name: Set Dosing Target
set_dosing_target.description: Set the target value for chemical dosing control.

target_value.name: Target value
target_value.description: Target value (0-100, unit depends on chemical)

set_light_color_pulse.name: Light Color Pulse
set_light_color_pulse.description: Send color pulse commands to pool lighting.

pulse_count.name: Number of pulses
pulse_count.description: How many color pulses to send (1-10).

set_omni_position.name: Set OmniTronic valve position
set_omni_position.description: Drive the OmniTronic multi-port valve to a fixed position (0-5). Position 0 returns to AUTO mode.

set_system_service.name: Toggle controller system service
set_system_service.description: Enable or disable a system service on the controller (FTP, Samba, SSH, AirPlay, HomeKit, Alexa, tunnels).

service.name: Service
service.description: Service identifier (ftp, samba, ssh, shairport, homebridge, alexa, tunnel, support_tunnel)

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

smart_dosing.name: Smart Dosing
smart_dosing.description:
Manual or automatic dosing control for pH, chlorine, electrolysis and flocculant.

H₂O₂ is not offered: the controller API has no H₂O₂ dosing function.

**Caution:** Avoid overdosing! Always check water values beforehand.

dosing_type.name: Dosing chemical
dosing_type.description: Select the chemical type (pH-, pH+, Chlorine, Electrolysis, Flocculant).

safety_override.name: Override safety interval
safety_override.description: Skip the safety interval between dosing cycles.

test_connection.name: Test Connection
test_connection.description: Test connection to the controller and return diagnostic information.

test_output.name: Output Test Mode
test_output.description: Temporarily activates a controller output for diagnostics. Make sure no people or equipment are at risk while the output is forced.

output.name: Output identifier
output.description: Identifier such as PUMP, HEATER or SOLAR.
